name: tickr
description: Tickr — team project and task manager (monorepo: backend/ Supabase, frontend/ Vite React, packages/db-types).

scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --workdir backend > packages/db-types/src/database.ts && prettier --write packages/db-types/src/database.ts
scripts.db:types:check: npm run db:types && git diff --exit-code -- packages/db-types/src/database.ts
